children.value: manāgapi kṛto yena tenāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam
saṃ * *? nti guṇāḥ śuddhaḥ saraḥ pūrṇamivāṇḍajaḥ
na vivekalavaṃ prauḍhaṃ bhaṅktuṃ śaktā durāśayāḥ
na vicāramayaṃ ceto yasyāsau mṛta ucyate
samaṃ svarūpamamalaṃ jñeyaṃ brahma paraṃ viduḥ
citraṃ pariśeṣādghanaṃ kāṃsyatālādi ca yadvādyaṃ tatsvaneṣu ca

kauśeyānīva mṛdusnigdhāni dalajālāni pallavasamūhā yeṣviti
prāktanasānuviśeṣaṇam
nināde ca mṛgendrāṇāṃ na kṣubhyati manāgapi
na bibheti na vādatte vaivaśyaṃ na ca dīnatām
bhuktvā jarayati kṣipraṃ klinnaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca mṛṣṭavat
na hṛṣyati glāyati vā sadā samatayeddhayā
na haranti vikalpaughā jalaughā iva parvatam
ādāvante ca yannāsti vartamāne'pi tasya ca
na śṛṇotyapi śṛṇvaṃśca na spṛśatyapi ca spṛśan
saṅgaṃ tyaja tvaṃ bhāvānāṃ jīvanmukto bhavānagha
saṅgaḥ kumucyate brūhi samāsena mama prabho
malinā vāsanā yaiṣā sā saṅga iti kathyate
ta * * *? tkriyate karma na tadbandhāya vai punaḥ
yadi tiṣṭhasi nirvyagraḥ kurvannapi na lipyase
duḥkhairna glānimāyāsi yadi hṛṣyasi no sukhaiḥ
saṃvedyo yadi caivātmā vedite lakṣyate samaḥ
bhogavikṣepādihetau vastujāle sadā samagre pracuratare satyapi samāśayaḥ

antarbahirapyadīnaṃ spṛhā yāñcādidainyavarjitaṃ sattvaṃ yasya
svavarṇāśramocitasahajakramasthādvyāpāramātrādanyatkiṃcidapyasau na karoti

athāpadaṃ prāpya susaṃpadaṃ vā
mahāmatiḥ svaprakṛtaṃ svabhāvam

jahāti no mandaravellito'pi
śauklyaṃ yathā kṣīramayāmburāśiḥ

saṃprāpya sāmrājyamathāpadaṃ vā
sarīsṛpatvaṃ suranāthatāṃ vā

dhiyeddhayā punariha janmabandhanai-
rna badhyase samadhigatātmadṛśyayā
